calc.explanation: Commercials are net long 17,475 contracts, up 2,033 from last week. This is the 2nd consecutive week of improving commercial positioning. The current reading is in the upper 100% of its six-month range and the upper 100% of its 12-month range. Positioning is near a 2yr-high extreme. A bullish nodule formed on 2026-07-28. This indicates neutral hedging inside a broader commercial buy program.

oi_driver.note: Open interest is unwinding, not building — usually position-closing, not a fresh directional tell.

williams_read.note: Positioning sits at a rare bullish extreme, but open interest isn't confirming fresh commercial conviction behind it right now (Large Speculators is driving this week's falling open interest instead). Williams treats an unconfirmed extreme as lower-probability than a confirmed one — worth waiting for the two to line up.
